subject: Time Management
title: Managing the Final 30 Days Before the Exam
preview: Use the final revision period for consolidation, error correction and sustainable timed practice.

sections.title: Consolidate efficiently
points: Review your existing core resources and high-risk areas; a large last-minute source switch can create confusion.
Use targeted practice to distinguish “forgotten knowledge” from “misread stem” errors.

sections.title: Protect performance
points: Schedule breaks and sleep to preserve attention and retrieval.
Measure progress with unfamiliar practice questions, not only notes that feel easy to recognize.

sections.title: Exam trap
points: Do not invent a universal countdown plan that ignores each student’s starting point.
A last-minute flood of new material can displace well-consolidated knowledge.

quickRevision: Prioritize recurring mistakes and previously studied high-value concepts.
Use short retrieval sessions, carefully selected timed tests and deliberate recovery.
Adjust the plan to the official upcoming examination schedule and personal performance.

quiz.question: What is a sensible final-month exam priority?
options: Targeted active recall with weakness repair
quiz.explanation: Targeted active recall with weakness repair. Freeze Your Resources: Do not start new textbooks, coaching notes, or lecture videos in the last month.
